snippet.title: Something Beautiful - Gameplay Trailer 2026
snippet.description:
Something Beautiful - A game by the artist Murlo is now available to wish list on the Steam store site.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4041730/Something_Beautiful

Something Beautiful is an immersive, music-driven point-and-click adventure game. Explore detailed, atmospheric environments, solve intricate puzzles, and experience a compelling story from musician and visual artist Murlo.

Follow the progress on the Murlo instagram page 
https://instagram.com/murlo
